inference_scope: stochastic uncertainty across independent frozen-GABM replications/seeds

practical_significance_interpretation.A: Holm-significant and effect magnitude >= MDE: statistically detectable and managerially meaningful
practical_significance_interpretation.B: Holm-significant but |effect| < MDE: statistically detectable but below pre-specified managerial relevance threshold
practical_significance_interpretation.C: not Holm-significant but point estimate >= MDE: managerially sized point estimate with insufficient confirmatory precision
practical_significance_interpretation.D: neither: no confirmatory evidence of managerially meaningful effect
